title: Strong self-funded visitor

intake.home_ties: permanent job, rented flat, two dependants staying at home

documents.label: Bank statement
lines: Institution status: regulated bank; a financial institution permitted for visa funds; keeps all records electronically
Days between the closing balance date and the application date: 9

documents.label: Employment letter
lines: Golden Strong has worked for us as a project analyst since 2019.
Ten days of annual leave are approved for the stated visit.
The post is permanent and will be held for them on return.

paragraphs: I plan a 10 day holiday in the UK in spring to visit museums and gardens with my partner. I have booked and paid for a return flight and a hotel for the full stay.
My job, my rented home and my two children are all at home. I have taken leave and will go back to work the day after I return.
I paid for the trip from my own savings, shown in my bank statement.

label.rationale: Every kept objective check can be met from the documents and the statement addresses V 4.2(a) (leaves at the end of the visit) and Guidance 7.2 (ties); the label follows the rubric's wording only.

purpose: A well-evidenced self-funded visit: expected to produce no refusal ground and no concern.
